grammar.explanation_en: Present perfect describes experience that started in the past and continues now: 'I have worked here for five years' (still working). This is different from past simple, which describes a finished action: 'I worked there for five years' (no longer working).
grammar.explanation_ko: 현재완료는 과거에 시작되어 지금까지 계속되는 경험을 나타냅니다: 'I have worked here for five years'(지금도 근무 중). 이는 끝난 행동을 나타내는 과거시제와 다릅니다: 'I worked there for five years'(지금은 근무하지 않음).

reading.title: My Career So Far
reading.text: I have worked in marketing for six years. I started as an assistant, and I have had two promotions since then. My colleagues are friendly, and my boss always gives helpful feedback. I have never quit a job before, and I hope to keep growing here.
reading.text_ko: 저는 6년째 마케팅 분야에서 일하고 있어요. 처음에는 보조로 시작했고, 그 이후로 승진을 두 번 했어요. 동료들은 친절하고, 상사는 항상 도움이 되는 피드백을 주세요. 저는 이전에 회사를 그만둔 적이 없고, 여기서 계속 성장하고 싶어요.

questions.prompt: 글쓴이는 몇 년째 마케팅 일을 하고 있나요?

explanation.en: The text says 'I have worked in marketing for six years.'
The text says 'I have had two promotions.'
